contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IVLIA MA MAEA AVG ; R/ VENERI FELICI

Copper alloy coin with silver wash. Plated denarius of Julia Mamaea (221-235), mint of Rome, RIC vol. 4 part 2 page 99 no. 351. Obverse description: Bust coifed with peak and draped right. Obverse inscription: IVLIA MA MAEA AVG. Reverse description: Figure standing right, draped to the waist, holding vertical sceptre and Cupid on left hand. Reverse inscription: VENERI FELICI. Diameter: 18mm, Weight: 2.16gms, die axis: 12
